blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Melatonin is produced in humans by the pineal gland. A favorite of travelers, it helps to support restful sleep.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: 1 tablet at bedtime. Do not exceed the suggested use.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Dibasic calcium phosphate, microcrystalline cellulose, stearic acid, magnesium stearate, and silica.
Contains no yeast, dairy, egg, gluten, corn, soy or wheat.
Contains no sugar, starch, salt, preservatives, or artificial color, flavor or fragrance.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Use only at bedtime. For adult use only. Not for use by children, teenagers, or women who are pregnant, may become pregnant or breastfeeding. Do not drive, operate machinery or consume alcohol or other sedatives while taking this product. If you are under medical supervision, or have an autoimmune disease, diabetes, a depressive disorder, a thyroid condition, epilepsy, leukemia, or a lymphoproliferative disorder, or are taking MAO inhibitor drugs or corticosteroids such as hydrocortisone or prednisone, consult your physician before taking this product. Do not take with alcoholic beverages or when operating machinery or driving a vehicle.
Store in a cool, dry place.
Do not use if either tamper-evident seal is broken or missing. Keep out of the reach of children.
